dex.entry: An ancient bark-golem so old that saplings have begun growing from its back. It stands immobile as a boulder for centuries and only moves when the forest is threatened. A walking old-growth forest — the awe moment of realising the clearing you just walked through was a sleeping kin.

art.silhouette: Massive standing golem of layered stone-bark, a living forest growing from its shoulders (small ferns, mosses, a small sapling), deep carved-wood face half-hidden by roots, feet rooted into the ground.
